subject: Cedarline compliance & retention alignment — post-call recap
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.ch@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@cedarline.com>, Maya Lin <maya.lin@cedarline.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 9 Mar 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Cedarline compliance & retention alignment — post-call recap

Thanks again for the call earlier — quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned. High level notes below, please reply with any corrections.

Key pain points you reiterated:
- Audit log retention and searchability (7+ years for some payment trails; current vendor extracts are large CSVs)
- Need SOC 2 scope alignment (system boundaries, where Redwood sits in the data flow)
- DPA/DPA annex signoff + specific retention clause language (legal & procurement)
- Pen test evidence and remediation timeline visibility for internal auditors

Goals we discussed:
1) Provide a minimal evidence package so your auditors can understand coverage (SOC 2 in-scope controls, sample audit logs, system diagram).
2) Agree retention policy and DPA language for logs and KV cache.
3) Schedule a short technical walkthrough of audit log formats and demo of our export tooling.

Action items (owner, ETA):
- Cedarline: share a one-page list of controls your auditor needs prioritized (Sanjay/Maya) — ETA 2027-03-11
- Redwood: send SOC 2 in-scope controls summary and a redacted sample audit-log export (Irene) — ETA 2027-03-10 (attached: SOC2-in-Scope-Controls.pdf, audit-log-sample.csv)
- Redwood Security: attach pen-test executive summary and remediation plan (Ben) — ETA 2027-03-10
- Procurement alignment: share MPA/PO template so we can map retention clauses (Cedarline procurement) — ETA 2027-03-12

Quick notes on technical constraints we highlighted during the call:
- Our KV cache is ephemeral by default; we can configure a persistent audit trail export to S3/GCS with configurable retention windows.
- For long-retention requests (7+ years) we recommend scheduled exports + cold storage. That increases egress and storage cost; we'll include an estimate in next deliverable.

Next proposed touchpoints:
- Wed 2027-03-10 11:00 PT: 30m technical walkthrough (log format + export demo)
- Fri 2027-03-12: procurement sync to align DPA/MPA language

If that schedule works, I'll lock invites and share the Drive folder with the artifacts we referenced.

Best,

Irene Choi
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

We'll take the 11:00 PT walkthrough tomorrow; Sanjay, Maya + 2 from infrastructure will join.
